scope: A 24-row clean and planted table of two variables and of three, and a 20-period and a 24-period series with one planted period each.
independence_basis: The generator rebuilds every table from the stated formulas, computes every leverage, the least-squares coefficients with and without the planted row and the robust z-scores in exact rational arithmetic on the float inputs, and imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the stated table.
historical_exposure: Written for this fixture from the stated tables and the definition of leverage; no product implementation source was consulted. Planted designs were chosen after probing which lifts the subset refuter separates from the clean table, so the lift sizes are tuned to the product; the derivation states the design property, not the verdict. A later revision followed inspection of the product resampling implementation and observed clean-series results; it no longer claims every stochastic diagnostic must pass for a clean series.
redistribution: Repository-authored MIT OR Apache-2.0 generator and deterministic inputs. Python standard library only, in an isolated locked script environment, outside the product and ordinary CI; no upstream source is stored.
limitations: The reference derives the design property (one row decides the fit, or is far from the bulk) and not the refuter's p-value, which depends on the seeded subsets; the verdicts are asserted against the design. Fixed static checks and the planted comparison are asserted on these tables; a clean temporal series is not guaranteed to pass a stochastic resampling diagnostic. Only the anomaly attribution is held; a change attribution validation is a refusal. No uncertainty or calibration.
